listeners.doc: Webhook listener that dispatches each inbound QuickBooks CloudEvents notification to the concrete service type matching its entity.

serviceTypes.doc: Receives QuickBooks company currency events: updated, deleted, and created.

rules.message: A CompanyCurrencyService must declare at least one of onCompanyCurrencyUpdated, onCompanyCurrencyDeleted, onCompanyCurrencyCreated, otherwise this event is received and silently dropped.
